column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3:
A demon from another
world can wear any face.{page_break}You all turn to Mia
when someone is hurt.
I've watched that.{page_break}You trust her hands.
You trust her voice.
Trust is so fragile.{page_break}I could make them
turn to me instead.{end_wait}

You have her face.
But you're not Mia.
Who are you?{page_break}You speak like her,
but something in you
is wrong.{end_wait}

My name is Kegare.
I came from a world
you'll never know.{page_break}I learned her voice.
I copied her face.
Now I'll take her place.{page_break}And when they call
for Mia in the dark,
I'll be the one who comes.{end_wait}

You can look like her.
She is still here.
We know who she is.{page_break}You can't take away
the life she's lived
by stealing her face.{end_wait}

You learned my face.
Did you learn the names
of those I cared for?{page_break}Did you sit with them
through fever and fear?
Did you stay until dawn?{end_wait}

They'll hear my voice
and call me Mia.
You'll be forgotten.{page_break}They won't know the
difference until
it's far too late.{end_wait}

In Imil, I stayed
when they were sick.
You can't undo that.{page_break}You may borrow my face.
You cannot borrow
what I chose to do.{end_wait}
